about: Each operation the twin serves, in both lanes (api: the read API; site: the site's forms), the demand that brings it in (journeys/demand.json) and how it is served. The site's pages are its workspace screens (site/src/manifest.ts screens), drawing what these operations made. The api lane is in scope by the life and the README's examples, not by an application (demand.json measured); jobstories, which neither reaches, answers the gap.

decisions.why: An item as the site made it, in the README's shape, read from the one store; an id no item has reads as Firebase reads an empty location (null), which the core's not-found cannot say.

decisions.demand: volter-ai/media (launch/dry-run f6a2a08) gtm/channels.yaml:95 (the owner signs in at their first session); the owner's dry-run brief, relayed by the orchestrator 2026-10-03: the person posts, comments, replies, and checks that the account switch and the upvote work (journeys/demand.json measured); no line of volter-ai/media states it
decisions.why: The login page's two forms, posting to the page's own address with the return page in its query: a sign-in checked against the person's password hash, or an account made under the create-account rules, each answered with the user cookie and the goto page, or the forms again with what went wrong.

decisions.demand: volter-ai/media (launch/dry-run f6a2a08) gtm/channels.yaml:95 (the owner signs in at their first session)
decisions.why: The submit page drawn signed out carries the login forms, posting to the submit page's own address: the sign-in (or new account) as the login page makes it, answered with the submit page itself (news.arc submit-login-warning).

The submit form: a story (a link, a question, a Show HN) whose first point is its submitter's, written to the store and the user's submissions; a url a live story already holds sends the submitter to it and counts as their vote (news.arc process-story); a title over 80 characters, an invalid url, or neither url nor text sends the page back with the site's words; refused signed out or without the form's own fnid.

decisions.demand: volter-ai/media (launch/dry-run f6a2a08) campaigns/2026-09-28-model-editor/campaign.md:13 (the maker's first comment right after); the replies: the owner's dry-run brief, relayed by the orchestrator 2026-10-03: the person posts, comments, replies, and checks that the account switch and the upvote work (journeys/demand.json measured); no line of volter-ai/media states it
decisions.why: The add comment and reply forms: a comment under its parent, the parent's kids ranked again and the story's descendants counted; refused signed out, without the form's hmac, or on a thread past two weeks (newsfaq). Signed out, the login forms carry the comment and post back here; signed in, the add comment page answers with the text kept (news.arc addcomment-page).

decisions.why: A vote link answered signed out carries the login forms, posting to the vote's own address: the sign-in, then the vote counted once and never on one's own post, on to the goto page.

Only an upvote (how=up): another direction is no vote here.
